cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example && set -o pipefail && P=.venv/bin/python && S=scripts/ringer/environment_narration && $P -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py tests/test_narration_json.py 2>&1 | tee /tmp/env-confirm.out | tail -5 && ! grep -Eq '[0-9]+ (failed|error|xfailed)' /tmp/env-confirm.out && env CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=dummy-acct CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN=dummy-token-xyz $P $S/smoke_direct.py --prompts bench/results/environment-narration/smoke-probe-prompts.json --dry --slots confirm --variants llama-3.3-70b-default-temp --out /tmp/env-confirm-plan.json | tail -2 && $P - <<'PY'
import json
a=json.load(open('/tmp/env-confirm-plan.json'))['calls']
assert len(a)==30, len(a)
assert [c['start'] for c in a[:4]]==['S5b','S5bA','S5b','S5bA']
assert [c['sample'] for c in a if c['start']=='S5b']==list(range(15))
by={}
for c in a: by.setdefault(c['start'],c['user'])
assert 'holds nothing else the player can find' in by['S5b'] and 'Nothing is left in or under the drawer. Searching the drawer finds nothing.' in by['S5bA']
print('confirm plan ok: 30 calls')
PY
! grep -rF dummy-token-xyz /tmp/env-confirm-plan.json && $P -m ruff check $S/smoke_direct.py tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py && $P -m ruff format --check $S/smoke_direct.py tests/test_environment_smoke_direct.py
